content_of_post_to_answer: Can childhood emotional neglect affect you as an adult, even if nothing "bad" ever happened?
answer: Yes. Emotional neglect can be difficult to recognize precisely because there may be no obvious incident to point to. A child can have food, shelter, education and parents who never hit them, yet grow up feeling that their emotions are an inconvenience. The lasting effect is often not a memory of being mistreated, but an inability to recognize their own needs, trust their feelings or feel comfortable depending on others. Sometimes what was missing becomes so familiar that you mistake it for your personality.
